Proposition
[Aleksandrov structure of locally convex subsets] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0443 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h15-minimal-geodesics-locally-convex 1. apph:H.17\group Locally convex subsets

If $\sec _{\M }\ge k$ and $C$ is connected, closed, and locally convex, then the length space $C$ is an Aleksandrov space with curvature bounded below by $k$.
